verdict.rationale: Greptile has dashboard-level settings that act as defaults. Org admins can set org-wide options under Settings → Code Review, and review controls such as strictness and custom rules exist. Per-repo exceptions are handled by a `greptile.json` file in each repository that overrides dashboard settings, so exceptions live in the repos rather than being managed centrally. Missing for 10: central management of per-repo exceptions from one console, evidence of bulk rollout across hundreds of repos, and any independent corroboration of org-scale configuration.
